title: Andok’s taps Rockport Power for retail electricity supply

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rockport Power Inc., a licensed retail electricity supplier, has secured a power supply deal to energize an initial 16 branches of Andok’s Litson Corp., a Filipino food chain known for its signature roasted chicken. The government’s retail aggregation program (RAP) made the deal possible by allowing households and smaller consumers in a shared area to consolidate their demand and meet the 100-kilowatt threshold. READ: Rockport Power upbeat on expansion after new license As a result, Rockport Power, based on the agreement, will supply electricity to 16 Andok’s branches in Quezon City, Makati, Manila, Cavite, and Tagaytay.
